## Slide 1: Introduction to Go

<!-- duration_seconds: 30.5 -->
<!-- sfx: keyboard-typing -->

Go is an open-source programming language designed for simplicity and performance.
It was created at Google and first released in 2009.

## Slide 2: Setting Up Your Environment

<!-- duration_seconds: 45.0 -->

Install Go from golang.org and set your GOPATH.
Use `go version` to verify the installation.
